text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0845 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.90 to C$0.40 lower with follow-through selling anticpated after weak close Monday. Early hedge selling also seen weighing on futures. Scale down crusher- related buying should however help to limit losses. The July WCE futures crush profit margin fell to -11.94 Monday from -10.42 Friday. Canada's dollar was weaker at C$1.4010 versus the U.S. dollar and dipped against the yen to 90.49.
FLAX - C$0.50 lower on an anticipated pickup in hedge related selling and the current lack of commercial demand.
WESTERN BARLEY - steady. Sentiment that Monday's late setback may have been overdone should help to underpin values.
FEED WHEAT - steady. Little direction provided by CBOT grain calls. Main feature likely to be continued liquidation of May positions ahead of Thursday's first delivery day.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
